name: Shrine of Aessina
summary: At the Shrine of Aessina, night elves honor an ancient spirit of nature and wild creatures. The sacred place lies in southwestern Ashenvale, between Maestra's Post and Astranaar, amid growing border friction.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Deep Woods
sections.body: West of Astranaar, the Shrine of Aessina honors a Wild God who embodies the heart and spirit of the deep forests. For generations, night elves and their woodland kin have revered this quiet place and communed with nature away from the main roads. The Horde is pushing into Ashenvale to gather timber and establish footholds, and sacred grounds across the territory face an uncertain peace.

faq.answer: Aessina is an ancient nature spirit and Wild God associated with the heart of pristine forests. Night elves and woodland beings honor her as nature's living soul, embodying the untamed wilderness.

faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Aessina located?
faq.answer: The shrine lies in southwestern Ashenvale, southwest of Maestra's Post and west of Astranaar.

faq.q: Why is this place significant to the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves honor the shrine as an ancient holy retreat dedicated to woodland spirits. It connects their society and druidic traditions directly to Kalimdor's untamed wilderness.

angles.text: As a druid devoted to preserving Kalimdor's natural balance, you honor the living spirit of the wild woods at this ancient shrine.
For the Kaldorei, the shrine represents centuries of harmony with Ashenvale's native spirits, now threatened by encroaching outside forces.
